_comment: Stage entries contain reactions only; the shower event owns physical narration. Self keys use receiver->receiver. Assisted keys use receiver->helper; Helper keys use helper->receiver. GetKojoEntry has no EP role/variant data, so stage entries deliberately have no COM role filters. requireRelationshipTypes checks the actual speaker->listener relationship, with any listed type matching; marriage/couple/FWB branches have an ungated fallback. Automatic accept/refuse entries opt into useEPPartnerAsTarget so an injected master never replaces the action partner. Base COM entry is refusal-only; stage End owns completion.

zh-cn.kojo_shower_refuse_self: $self$摇摇头。"我现在不想洗，晚些再说。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_accept_helper_marriage: $self$朝$target$笑了笑。"好，我帮你洗。水太热了就告诉我，别忍着。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_accept_helper_couple: $self$轻快地应道："好啊，我帮你洗，背后够不到的地方交给我。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_accept_helper_fwb: $self$点点头。"可以，帮你洗干净。今天就做这个。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_accept_helper_fallback: $self$应道："可以，我来帮你清洗。不舒服就说。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_accept_receiver_marriage: $self$的语气松快下来。"那就麻烦你了，背后我自己总是够不着。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_accept_receiver_couple: $self$有些不好意思地笑了。"嗯，想请你帮我洗。动作轻一点就好。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_accept_receiver_fallback: $self$点头。"谢谢，请帮我洗一下。需要我换姿势就告诉我。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_refuse_helper_marriage: $self$抱歉地看向$target$。"我现在实在顾不过来，没法帮你洗。等一会儿吧。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_refuse_helper_couple: $self$轻声回道："抱歉，我现在不方便帮你洗。不是在生你的气。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_refuse_helper_fwb: $self$摇头。"今天不帮忙洗澡，你自己来吧。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_refuse_helper_fallback: $self$回道："抱歉，我现在不能帮你清洗。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_refuse_receiver_marriage: $self$轻轻摇头。"不用啦，今天我想自己洗。毛巾留给我就好。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_refuse_receiver_couple: $self$有些迟疑。"今天还不想让你帮我洗，给我一点自己的时间吧。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_refuse_receiver_fwb: $self$直截了当地说："不用帮我洗，熟归熟，这次我想自己来。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_refuse_receiver_fallback: $self$摇头。"不用帮忙，我不想让别人替我洗。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_self_expel: $self$缓缓呼出一口气。"不急，慢慢清理干净。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_self_rinse: $self$低声嘀咕："再冲一下，别留下泡沫。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_undress_marriage: $self$自然地向$target$开口："衣服帮我放远一点吧，别让水溅到了。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_undress_couple: $self$笑得有些腼腆。"先别看我啦，帮我拿一下衣服。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_undress_fwb: $self$提醒$target$："衣服放干燥的地方，今天只管洗澡。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_undress_fallback: $self$略显拘谨地说："请先转过身，我准备好了会告诉你。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_beginwash_marriage: $self$放松了语气。"嗯，这样刚好。背后也拜托你了。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_beginwash_couple: $self$朝$target$笑了笑。"有点痒……轻一点就好。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_beginwash_fwb: $self$说道："这个力道可以，照这样洗就好。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_beginwash_fallback: $self$轻声提醒："麻烦轻一点，水温这样就可以。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperbegin_marriage: $self$温声问$target$："这个水温还舒服吗？太热了可别忍着。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperbegin_couple: $self$含着笑意问道："这样会痒吗？我再轻一点。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperbegin_fwb: $self$向$target$确认："水温和力道都行吧？不合适就说。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperbegin_fallback: $self$说道："我会慢慢洗，哪里不舒服请告诉我。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_expel_marriage: $self$有些难为情地开口："等我缓一下……有你帮着，安心多了。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_expel_couple: $self$小声对$target$说："有点不好意思，先让我缓口气。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_expel_fwb: $self$认真地说道："先别开玩笑，让我把残留清理干净。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_expel_fallback: $self$低声请求："麻烦等一下，让我自己清理这部分。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperexpel_marriage: $self$温声安慰$target$："慢慢来，不用急。我在这儿。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperexpel_couple: $self$放轻声音。"不用不好意思，要我先转过身也可以。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperexpel_fwb: $self$认真应道："不闹你，先清理干净。需要停就说。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperexpel_fallback: $self$向$target$说道："我先等着，你准备好了再叫我。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_rinse_marriage: $self$轻声说道："肩膀后面再冲一下吧，那儿好像还有泡沫。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_rinse_couple: $self$笑着提醒$target$："水别冲到脸上，其他地方都挺舒服的。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_rinse_fwb: $self$说道："再冲一遍就好，别留着沐浴露。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_rinse_fallback: $self$向$target$确认："背后还有泡沫吗？麻烦再帮我冲一下。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperrinse_marriage: $self$柔声提醒$target$："最后再冲一下肩背，别急着走，地上滑。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperrinse_couple: $self$说道："水不会冲到你脸上的，低一下头就好。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperrinse_fwb: $self$对$target$说道："最后冲一遍，沐浴露得洗干净。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperrinse_fallback: $self$提醒道："我要冲洗背后了，请站稳。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_end_marriage: $self$朝$target$露出轻松的笑容。"清爽多了，谢谢。你也记得把手擦干。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_end_couple: $self$有点腼腆地笑了。"谢谢你，连背后都洗干净了，舒服多了。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_end_fwb: $self$满意地点头。"洗干净了，多谢帮忙。今天这样就好。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_end_fallback: $self$松了口气。"谢谢，剩下的我自己来就行。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperend_marriage: $self$关切地叮嘱$target$："好了，擦干再穿衣服，别着凉。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperend_couple: $self$笑着说道："洗好了，慢慢出来，别滑倒。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperend_fwb: $self$向$target$说道："好了，清洗完了。记得擦干。"
zh-cn.kojo_shower_helperend_fallback: $self$说道："清洗完成了，需要帮忙的话再叫我。"

en-us.kojo_shower_accept_self: $self$ agrees. "Yes, I'll go take a shower."
en-us.kojo_shower_refuse_self: $self$ shakes their head. "I don't want a shower right now. Later."
en-us.kojo_shower_accept_helper_marriage: $self$ smiles at $target$. "All right, I'll help you wash. Tell me if the water gets too hot; don't put up with it."
en-us.kojo_shower_accept_helper_couple: $self$ readily agrees. "Of course I'll help. Leave the places on your back you can't reach to me."
en-us.kojo_shower_accept_helper_fwb: $self$ nods. "Sure, I'll help you get clean. That's all we're doing today."
en-us.kojo_shower_accept_helper_fallback: $self$ agrees. "I can help you wash. Tell me if anything feels uncomfortable."
en-us.kojo_shower_accept_receiver_marriage: $self$ sounds relieved. "Thank you. I can never quite reach my back."
en-us.kojo_shower_accept_receiver_couple: $self$ smiles a little shyly. "Yes, I'd like your help washing. Just be gentle."
en-us.kojo_shower_accept_receiver_fwb: $self$ looks at $target$. "All right. Just help me wash, no fooling around."
en-us.kojo_shower_accept_receiver_fallback: $self$ nods. "Thank you, please help me wash. Tell me if you need me to change position."
en-us.kojo_shower_refuse_helper_marriage: $self$ looks apologetically at $target$. "I really can't manage helping you wash right now. Give me a little time."
en-us.kojo_shower_refuse_helper_couple: $self$ answers softly. "Sorry, I can't help you wash right now. I'm not upset with you."
en-us.kojo_shower_refuse_helper_fwb: $self$ shakes their head. "I'm not helping with a shower today. You'll have to wash yourself."
en-us.kojo_shower_refuse_helper_fallback: $self$ replies, "Sorry, I can't help you wash right now."
en-us.kojo_shower_refuse_receiver_marriage: $self$ gently shakes their head. "No need. I'd like to wash on my own today. Just leave me a towel."
en-us.kojo_shower_refuse_receiver_couple: $self$ hesitates. "I'd rather you didn't help me wash today. I need a little time to myself."
en-us.kojo_shower_refuse_receiver_fwb: $self$ says plainly, "I don't need help washing. We know each other well, but I'd rather do this myself."
en-us.kojo_shower_refuse_receiver_fallback: $self$ shakes their head. "No help, thank you. I don't want someone else washing me."
en-us.kojo_shower_self_beginwash: $self$ sighs with relief. "That's just the right temperature."
en-us.kojo_shower_self_expel: $self$ slowly breathes out. "No rush. Just get everything clean."
en-us.kojo_shower_self_rinse: $self$ mutters, "One more rinse. Don't leave any soap behind."
en-us.kojo_shower_self_end: $self$ gives a contented sigh. "That's much fresher."
en-us.kojo_shower_undress_marriage: $self$ speaks easily to $target$. "Could you put my clothes a little farther away, out of the spray?"
en-us.kojo_shower_undress_couple: $self$ smiles shyly. "Don't look just yet. Could you take my clothes?"
en-us.kojo_shower_undress_fwb: $self$ reminds $target$, "Keep my clothes somewhere dry. It's just a shower today."
en-us.kojo_shower_undress_fallback: $self$ says a little stiffly, "Please turn around first. I'll tell you when I'm ready."
en-us.kojo_shower_beginwash_marriage: $self$ sounds relaxed. "Yes, that's just right. My back too, please."
en-us.kojo_shower_beginwash_couple: $self$ smiles at $target$. "That tickles a little... Just a bit gentler."
en-us.kojo_shower_beginwash_fwb: $self$ says, "That pressure is fine. Keep washing like that."
en-us.kojo_shower_beginwash_fallback: $self$ says quietly, "Please be gentle. The temperature is fine as it is."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperbegin_marriage: $self$ asks $target$ gently, "Is the water comfortable? Don't put up with it if it's too hot."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperbegin_couple: $self$ asks with a smile, "Does that tickle? I'll be a little gentler."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperbegin_fwb: $self$ checks with $target$. "Temperature and pressure all right? Say if they're not."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperbegin_fallback: $self$ says, "I'll take it slowly. Please tell me if anything feels uncomfortable."
en-us.kojo_shower_expel_marriage: $self$ sounds a little embarrassed. "Give me a moment... Having you help makes this easier."
en-us.kojo_shower_expel_couple: $self$ tells $target$ quietly, "This is a little embarrassing. Let me catch my breath first."
en-us.kojo_shower_expel_fwb: $self$ says seriously, "No jokes for a moment. Let me clear out what's left."
en-us.kojo_shower_expel_fallback: $self$ asks quietly, "Please wait a moment. Let me take care of this part myself."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperexpel_marriage: $self$ reassures $target$ gently. "Take your time. There's no rush. I'm here."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperexpel_couple: $self$ lowers their voice. "No need to be embarrassed. I can turn away if you'd like."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperexpel_fwb: $self$ answers seriously. "No teasing. Let's get you clean first. Say if you need to stop."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperexpel_fallback: $self$ tells $target$, "I'll wait. Let me know when you're ready."
en-us.kojo_shower_rinse_marriage: $self$ says softly, "Behind my shoulders once more, please. I think there's still some soap there."
en-us.kojo_shower_rinse_couple: $self$ reminds $target$ with a smile, "Keep the water off my face. Everything else feels lovely."
en-us.kojo_shower_rinse_fwb: $self$ says, "One more rinse should do it. Don't leave any body wash behind."
en-us.kojo_shower_rinse_fallback: $self$ checks with $target$. "Is there still soap on my back? Please rinse it once more."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperrinse_marriage: $self$ gently reminds $target$, "One last rinse over your shoulders and back. No rushing off; the floor is slippery."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperrinse_couple: $self$ says, "I'll keep it off your face. Just lower your head a little."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperrinse_fwb: $self$ tells $target$, "One last rinse. All the body wash needs to come off."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperrinse_fallback: $self$ says, "I'm going to rinse your back now. Please keep your footing."
en-us.kojo_shower_end_marriage: $self$ gives $target$ a relaxed smile. "Much fresher, thank you. Remember to dry your hands too."
en-us.kojo_shower_end_couple: $self$ smiles a little shyly. "Thank you. Even my back is clean now. That feels much better."
en-us.kojo_shower_end_fwb: $self$ nods in satisfaction. "All clean. Thanks for helping. That's enough for today."
en-us.kojo_shower_end_fallback: $self$ sighs with relief. "Thank you. I can manage the rest myself."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperend_marriage: $self$ tells $target$ with concern, "All done. Dry off before getting dressed; don't catch a chill."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperend_couple: $self$ says with a smile, "All clean. Come out slowly; don't slip."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperend_fwb: $self$ tells $target$, "Done. You're all clean. Remember to dry off."
en-us.kojo_shower_helperend_fallback: $self$ says, "That's the washing finished. Let me know if you need help again."
